title: Central gap: VC lower bound gd_VC = ∞ is entirely outsourced as a black box

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The whole content of the hard half of part (1)–(2) of the problem — that the exhibited group satisfies $\gd_{\VC}\Gamma=\infty$ — is asserted as Theorem `thm:LP` (Leary–Petrosyan) and invoked "at the level of its conclusion" (see Theorem `thm:LP`, Remark `rem:blackbox`, and the proof of part (2) of `thm:main`). No proof, and not even a reproduction of the cohomological estimate, is given.

The mechanism (Lück–Weiermann decomposition + unbounded $\cd(W_C)$ of the Weyl groups $W_C=N_\Gamma[C]/C$) appears only in Remark `rem:mechanism`, which is **explicitly flagged as non-rigorous and not part of the logical chain**.

Under a 'prove from scratch' standard this is the decisive gap: the only genuinely nontrivial obstruction in the entire problem (the non-existence of a finite-dimensional $E_{\VC}\Gamma$) is assumed rather than proved. The headline separation statement therefore rests on an uncited-in-detail black box.

To close: either (i) reproduce a rigorous lower-bound argument $\gd_{\VC}\Gamma=\infty$ for a specific group via the Lück–Weiermann Bredon Mayer–Vietoris sequence and explicit unbounded Weyl-group dimensions, or (ii) acknowledge that this is the load-bearing external input and make the citation pinpoint-precise to a numbered theorem whose hypotheses are individually verified for the chosen group.
